parsed.internal_thinking: I have a Knight card in my hand (revealed) which I will use to clear the robber from Hex 7 (Wheat 8) and move it back to Hex 5 (Bob's Brick 6). This restores my wheat production and blocks Bob's only source of brick. After playing the knight, I will check my resources: I have 3 Wood, 1 Wheat, 1 Sheep, 1 Ore. I still need 1 Brick to build my settlement at Node 7 (Brick Port). I'll try to trade my excess wood for brick with Alice. If she refuses, I'll hold onto my resources for now.
parsed.note_to_self: Used Knight to move robber back to Hex 5 (Bob's Brick 6). Restored Wheat 8 production. Still need 1 Brick for the Node 7 settlement. Alice currently has 1 Wood, 1 Wheat, 2 Sheep. Bob has 2 Wood, 3 Wheat, 1 Sheep.
parsed.say_outloud: Sorry Bob, but I told you that Wheat 8 was doing just fine without your 'guest.' Back to the brick mines for you.
